hook: Jakob Uszkoreit grew up in Saarbrücken, Germany, and studied computer science and mathematics at the Berlin Institute of Technology, completing his master's degree summa cum laude in 2008. He joined Google that year after an earlier research internship, working first on data mining for Google Translate and later leading a semantic parsing team supporting Google Search and Assistant. In 2017 he co-authored Attention Is All You Need with colleagues at Google Brain, introducing the Transformer architecture that replaced recurrence and convolution with self-attention and became the foundation for most large language models built since. In 2021 he left Google to co-found Inceptive with biochemist Rhiju Das, applying deep learning models to the design of RNA-based medicines and pairing computational predictions with laboratory testing.
name: Jakob Uszkoreit

quote.text: Overall, this is a very typical phenomenon where we want to see revolutions, the truth is that almost all the revolutions that I've been a witness to are actually incremental progress.

quick_facts: Co-authored the 2017 paper Attention Is All You Need, which introduced the Transformer architecture
Worked at Google for over a decade, including on Google Translate's data mining team and later a semantic parsing team in the Machine Intelligence group
Holds a master's degree in computer science from the Berlin Institute of Technology, completed summa cum laude in 2008
Left Google in 2021 to co-found Inceptive, a company applying deep learning to RNA-based medicines
Inceptive pairs computational predictions of RNA behavior with wet-lab experiments led by biochemist Rhiju Das
